sharedContracts.name: CommandRegistry
sharedContracts.contract: ID/menu/key/scope/availability/order/help from one schema; include IDE conflict ownership and profile-specific localized gestures
sharedContracts.unknown: Original native availability and ordering per command

sharedContracts.name: WorkspaceConfiguration
sharedContracts.contract: Immutable active workspace/configuration/platform/language/file option snapshot; VS evaluated adapter and external build adapter; raw fallback marked incomplete
sharedContracts.unknown: Generic native parser compile flags and event ordering

sharedContracts.name: AnalysisScheduler
sharedContracts.contract: Subsystem-specific cancellation/revision/queue budgets; same-file exclusion where proven; reject stale result publication
sharedContracts.unknown: General parser limits; inspection limit must not apply globally

sharedContracts.name: CacheServices
sharedContracts.contract: Separate FileFinder lookup persistence, semantic symbol/reference index, compiler option caches; independent schema/context/generation/invalidation
sharedContracts.unknown: Semantic index layout and every cache invalidation condition

sharedContracts.name: EditTransaction
sharedContracts.contract: Snapshot version check, overlap detection, preview, coordinated multi-file Undo, caret/selection restore; cancellation before applying edits
sharedContracts.unknown: Original Undo grouping and refactoring-specific rollback edge cases

sharedContracts.name: SemanticBackend
sharedContracts.contract: Language-specific symbol identity/type/hierarchy/read-write/overloads and diagnostics; compiler and textual candidate results remain distinguishable
sharedContracts.unknown: All native semantics, C# provider behavior and incomplete-code heuristics

sharedContracts.name: SettingsSchema
sharedContracts.contract: Stored values, installation-help defaults and observed factory-reset values separate; version/theme/language constraints and dependent options explicit
sharedContracts.unknown: Most exact setting bindings and full factory palette

sharedContracts.name: UIResultModels
sharedContracts.contract: Stable identity, result kind, scope, filters, selection, sorting and cloning state independent from view; lazy data loading and cancellation

sharedContracts.name: SnippetEngine
sharedContracts.contract: Environment snapshot then reserved/template expansion; per-invocation shared input and GUID; inline field and dialog state independent from text mutation
sharedContracts.unknown: All reserved values, nested/escaped templates and inline Undo

sharedContracts.name: ValidationOracle
sharedContracts.contract: Per-feature original input/output/version/settings/caret/Undo/UI/key/performance evidence; full parity only when all relevant gates pass
sharedContracts.unknown: Required original runtime comparisons remain unexecuted

currentSourceEvidence.finding: Per-command linked cancellation source exists; shared command lifecycle not established.
Some navigation/refactoring commands delegate to VS commands; delegation is not native VA parity.
Exported creation listener ContentType is C/C++; all-language support not established.
Raw XML candidate collector differs from evaluated per-file configuration adapter.
Rename-specific preview and UndoContext handling exists; shared edit transaction not established.

batchImplementationEntryCriteria: Finish feature-specific analysis and resolve or explicitly test each unknown before claiming equivalence.
Confirm original2630 command/option/language availability including additional candidates.
Compare original runtime inputs before setting factory defaults or replacing semantic behaviors.
